titleEn: I Didn't Look at the Sky

pages.text: Bright spring sunshine filled the yard. Yuki dragged out their quilt. Momo hopped beside it.
"Today, my quilt will smell of sunshine." Yuki hung it on the line.
Yuki patted the quilt with both palms. Dust puffed out. "All done!"
Yuki went to play at the stream. The water was still cold. "I'll bring it in later."
Only Momo remained in the yard. Momo slipped beneath the porch and lay down.
Patter, patter—spring rain poured down. Yuki ran back to the yard.
The quilt sagged, dripping water. "The smell washed away."
Under the roof, Grandma said to herself, "What happens to a quilt when it rains?"
A few days later, the quilt hung on the line again. Clouds came over the mountain. "Clouds!" Yuki quickly took it down.
At night, Yuki buried their nose in the quilt. It smelled softly of sunshine.
